headline: Avantor Stock Surged Because One Segment Stopped Shrinking
summary: Organic revenue still fell, yet a segment returning to growth and a raised outlook were enough to reprice the stock in a single session.

headline: Aristotle Global Equity Advisory Q2 2026 Portfolio Review
